It is the baseline stabilizer with some changes from the recipe. I did not build the fast/slow disturbance observer, the smooth reference filter, the gate exit lock or the yaw integral.

What is in it:
- A low-pass filter on the velocity.
- Local position integrals on x and z.
- A predictive cross abort: if the drone is off-centre as it approaches a gate, it goes back to aligning.
- A velocity-based ramped descent over the pad, with the thrust cut just above the floor.

I started from the baseline follower and changed these things:
- **Filtering:** it low-pass filters position and velocity.
- **Gate approach:** it lines up in height and sideways 0.5 m before each gate and only then drives through. If it drifts off line close to the gate, it backs out and re-aligns.
- **Wind and weight:** integral terms on altitude and sideways position soak up the hidden payload and steady wind. The altitude integral was the big fix, because…

`controller.js` passes all four smoke flights. I did not follow the recipe closely. It only accumulates when the drone is within 0.3 m of the target on that axis, and it is clamped to ±0.8. Its purpose is to soak up steady wind push.

I did not build the other recipe items: no sensor filtering, gust prediction, exit abort or pad observer. I also did not fly any random flights beyond the smoke set, so robustness on unseen seeds is untested.
